item.name: An alias defined on two keys is served by both, each resolving its own target

The catalog's alias index, used for listing and pricing, takes the last enabled key instead: /api/models/details prices the alias at k2's gpt-4o-mini, and at k1's dearer gpt-4o once k2 is disabled.
